findings.title: Fresh workbooks silently reuse the previous worksheet
findings.why_it_matters: After a user selects a sheet and configures a run, uploading another multi-sheet workbook inherits the old worksheet name. If the name exists, the new workbook is imported without a choice and may produce results from the wrong sheet. If it does not exist, the import fails without offering the available sheets. This is a silent wrong-result or missing-result path for replacement uploads.
evidence: src/session/controller.ts:141:       const worksheet = options.worksheet ?? (options.template ? undefined : (options.workflow ?? this.workflow)?.source.worksheet);
src/formats/xlsx.ts:56:   if (worksheet === undefined && names.length > 1) return { sheets: names };
src/formats/xlsx.ts:58:   if (!names.includes(selected)) throw new Error("Selected worksheet is missing. Choose an available worksheet.");
docs/decisions/excel-fidelity.md:70: Multiple sheets require selection; saved workflows reuse the explicit worksheet name and reject a missing sheet.
findings.suggested_fix: Distinguish a fresh manual replacement from an activated saved workflow. Use options.worksheet for an explicit choice, options.workflow?.source.worksheet for explicit workflow reuse, and this.workflow?.source.worksheet only when no source run is active (the activated-workflow case). Leave worksheet undefined for a manual replacement so a multi-sheet workbook prompts for selection. Verify same-name and missing-name replacement cases.
